instruction.notes: The context filename is configurable via `context.fileName` in ~/.qwen/settings.json or .qwen/settings.json; QWEN.md is the default. Hierarchical: the global file supplies defaults for all projects, the project file overrides it.

skills.notes: Each skill is a directory containing SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter. Priority: Project > User > Extension > Bundled. Qwen Code watches the personal and project skill directories and refreshes automatically after a short delay — except in bare mode, which needs a restart. Re-checked 2026-10-14 against docs/users/features/skills.md at QwenLM/qwen-code@3071807: personal ~/.qwen/skills/, project .qwen/skills/ (requires a trusted workspace); skills are enabled by default, with skills.disabled / skills.defaultDisabled / skills.enabled settings.

quirks: Qwen Code is the actively maintained CLI (v0.24.0, released 2026-09-16). It is NOT the same product as the Qwen Chat agent — see profiles/qwen-agent.json.
A structured <thinking> trace is the natural fit here: Qwen models expose reasoning, so the grug variant's internal trace costs little and reads cleanly.
Skills are model-invoked: Qwen Code matches your request against the description field. A vague description means the skill never fires.
Skill directories are watched during a normal session and refresh automatically; bare mode needs a restart.
